title: Gatekeeper Validation Rules
description: 12 quality criteria for gatekeeper scoring (PBGD workflow, v4.0). GK-01..GK-11 are documentation-quality; GK-12 is Figma/reference ↔ implementation pixel-perfect conformance.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: All required sections and items exist without omission

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Content matches source digest and upstream documents

criteria.name: Consistency
criteria.description: IDs, terminology, and values are consistent across documents

criteria.name: Traceability
criteria.description: FR→US→FT→TC chain is complete without gaps

criteria.name: TOC Quality
criteria.description: Table of contents is logical, detailed enough, correct depth, no missing entries

criteria.name: Content Composition
criteria.description: Logical structure, natural section flow, key information properly placed

criteria.name: Visual Adequacy
criteria.description: Stars, cards, tables, lists used appropriately for content type

criteria.name: Diagram Fitness
criteria.description: Diagram types appropriate for subject, SVG renders correctly

criteria.name: Mermaid Integrity
criteria.description: No Mermaid syntax errors, renderable, no missing nodes/edges

criteria.name: JSON Sync
criteria.description: .md and .json companion are exactly synchronized, ID 10-increment rule

criteria.name: Cross-Reference
criteria.description: links.json dependency graph matches actual document references

criteria.name: Design Conformance
criteria.description: Implemented UI is PIXEL-PERFECT to the Figma source of truth and ingested reference materials: token parity, layout/bounds parity, component variant/state parity, text parity, plus reference-material semantic-rule coverage (validation/domain/permission/processing rules). Zero unresolved drift. Scored N/A (auto-pass 100) ONLY when no Figma/reference provenance exists (no dsFileKey, no figmaKey, no screens.figmaUrl, no data/digest/figma/*).

thresholds.note: Pixel-perfect GATE thresholds — stricter than the Build-phase iteration thresholds (SSIM 0.95 / 5% / ±2px) in visual-verify-ds.md / visual-verify-components.md. Tunable via --figma-ssim-threshold / --figma-diff-threshold.

required.note: GK-12 pixel-perfect. All registered Figma sources (dsFileKey, per-component figmaKey, per-screen figmaUrl) and ingested reference materials show design-conformance.json result==pass with zero coverageGaps. Any --no-figma-parity override at the GATE blocks deploy unless explicitly acknowledged. N/A-pass only when no Figma/reference provenance exists.

x-deprecated-pdca.description: Historical PDCA gates kept for v3→v4 migration reference only. Do not use.
